title: Define Product Registry scope and content boundary
requirements:
- State criteria for foundational data (authority, stability, reuse, identification)
- Define 'product' up front and state whether medical equipment is in scope
- Align the registry/catalogue boundary across placement, requirements, data table and comparison table
- Reassess storage, shelf-life, volumetric and clinical attributes against them
- Use a common identity core with class-specific extensions
- Replace the stable-versus-dynamic binary with update frequency and governance authority
- Keep batch, serial, shipment and custody events in operational systems
- Separate meanings of 'recognised for use' into distinct statuses
